The official City of Oklahoma City elections page states that the mayor is elected in even-numbered years every four years and council members in odd-numbered years. The Mayor page shows elections in 2018 and 2022, and the Upcoming Elections page lists the next mayoral general election for February 2030, which fixes the cycle at 2010, 2014, 2018, 2022 and 2026. The city's former mayors page shows Mick Cornett in office from March 2004 to April 2018 and David Holt from April 2018 to the present, so no vacancy or special mayoral election occurred. No mayoral round falls in 2011.
